surface_name: Scenario editor and API v2 scenario update
title: Scenario is switched off after you save it in the editor or update its blueprint
symptoms: isActive is false after a blueprint PATCH
Scheduled runs stop after an edit
cause: Saving a scenario in the web editor, and updating its blueprint through PATCH /scenarios/{id}, can leave the scenario inactive.
fix: After every edit, start the scenario again and confirm it is active and that a clean run follows.
apply: POST /api/v2/scenarios/{id}/start, then GET /api/v2/scenarios/{id} and check isActive is true.
affected: Make web editor and API v2, July to September 2026
